The assessment results in Fig. 1a show that the green tea Kombucha group (K-GT) exhibited a pale yellow-green liquid color, while the black tea Kombucha (K-BT) displayed an amber-colored liquid. Figures 1b and c indicate that the green tea Kombucha had a smooth and subtly sweet taste with a hint of vinegar flavor and a fresh tea aroma. The black tea Kombucha had a robust vinegar flavor intertwined with the floral and fruity notes characteristic of black tea, with a sweet and sour taste and a fizzy texture.
